comment: Regular words (every letter makes its basic sound), grouped by the first area in which all their letters have been taught; the words with two consonants together are in groups of their own, in the order the lessons on them use them (r before l). A word is cut into graphemes by the two-letter ones the curriculum teaches (quit is qu, i, t); a dot forces a cut where that would be wrong ("mis.hap"). No word begins with x: it says /ks/, which only comes after a vowel. The game only uses a word once its clip exists; scripts/audio-wanted.mjs lists the ones that do not.
